Scheduling that works while you don't.

AI agents that answer calls and book meetings. CRMs that stay in sync. Workflows that run themselves. All from one platform.

AI Booking Agents

  • Clients call, text, or WhatsApp — your agent books the meeting
  • Each agent has its own number, personality, and language
  • Speaks 9 languages so international leads never wait
  • Checks your calendar in real time — no double-bookings

Every Meeting Type

  • Auto-creates Google Meet, Zoom, Teams, or Webex links
  • Supports WhatsApp, Telegram, FaceTime, Discord, Slack calls
  • Phone, in-person, or any custom location you need

Team Scheduling

  • Invite your team and share one booking page
  • Round-robin assigns leads fairly across reps
  • Collective scheduling finds time when everyone is free
  • Set meeting limits so your team avoids burnout

CRM Integrations

  • HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio — contacts sync automatically
  • Meetings appear on timelines without manual entry
  • Bookings always go through, even if your CRM hiccups

Workflows & Automation

  • Routing forms qualify leads before they book
  • Trigger emails, SMS, webhooks, or AI calls after booking
  • Automated reminders cut no-shows by up to 80%
  • Connect 7,000+ apps via Zapier and Make.com

Developer Friendly

  • Full REST API — build custom booking flows
  • MCP server for Claude, Cursor, and Windsurf
  • Signed webhooks so you never miss an event
  • Embed widgets to keep visitors on your site

What if booking a meeting was as simple as sending a text?

Your customers text your number, AI handles the rest — checks availability, finds a slot, sends confirmation. No app. No link. No friction.

AI

Dr. Patel's Office

SMS · +1 (989) 693-3164

Hi, I’d like to book an appointment with Dr. Patel
Of course! Dr. Patel has these available: • 15-min check-up • 30-min consultation Which would you prefer?
The consultation please
Great! Next Thursday works — 9:30am, 1:00pm, or 3:30pm?
1pm
Done! You’re booked with Dr. Patel, Thursday at 1:00 PM. Confirmation sent to your email.
Text message...

Real conversation — AI books the meeting, checks availability, sends confirmation. Works on SMS and WhatsApp.

6 Booking Channels

Your customers book however they want

A link on your website. A text message. A phone call at midnight. LinkTime handles every channel — the same calendar, the same availability, the same confirmation flow.

Web Widget

Voice booking on your site

Every channel checks the same availability, creates the same booking, sends the same confirmation. No duplicate setups.

End to End

From first click to booked meeting — automated

Routing forms, CRM sync, and voice agents. Everything your sales team needs to book 10x more meetings.

Routing Form

Visitor fills out your intake form

Smart Routing

Matched to the right rep or event

Instant Booking

Books on your calendar automatically

CRM Sync

Contact + meeting logged in HubSpot, Attio, or Salesforce

Voice Agent

AI agents book meetings 24/7 via phone or web

Enterprise Ready

Built to scale with your team

Custom domains, SSO, SCIM provisioning, and admin controls. Everything IT and ops need to roll out scheduling org-wide.

Custom Domains

Replace linktime.io with meetings.yourcompany.com. DNS verification, automatic SSL, guided setup in 5 minutes.

SSO / SAML

Self-serve SAML setup for Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace. One-click login for your entire team.

Admin Dashboard

Monitor bookings, revenue, costs, and team activity across your organization from a single view.

SCIM Provisioning

Auto-sync users from Okta or Azure AD. New hires get access instantly, departing employees are deprovisioned.

If your team books 50+ meetings/month, voice agents + CRM sync + routing forms pay for themselves in week one.
